# `bs move`

- **Usage:** `bs move [--set <SET>] [--dry-run] <ID> <DESTINATION>`

Move a bit to a shelf or a new shelf/name ID without overwriting

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`**
- **`<DESTINATION>`**

## Flags
- **`--set <SET>`** — Set a frontmatter string: KEY=VALUE (repeatable; timestamps reserved)
- **`--dry-run`** — Validate and preview without changing files
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
